description: Land Title Settlement Department - Koongasthenna, D/S Division, Weligepola, Ratnapura District, - Cad. Map No. 620122 and others
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, cadastral maps, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner General of Land Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlements, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
